projects.name: Senior Lead | Enterprise Program Delivery | FIS GLOBAL
details: Jul 2025 – Jul 2026 • Chennai, India
• Led Value Stream design and transformation for the Enterprise Prepaid Payments organization, aligning 110+
engineers across 8 Journey and 3 Kanban teams and coordinating Product Owners, Product Managers and System
Architects across North America, Europe and Canada; established delivery governance, PI readiness and portfolio
visibility to coordinate multi-team PI and sprint execution.
• Managed enterprise prepaid and payment programs within FIS Banking and Payments Services, coordinating
Product, Engineering, Architecture and delivery stakeholders across North America, Europe and Canada and driving
governance across multi-geography payment initiatives.
• Established structured programme governance covering delivery status, dependencies, risks, readiness criteria,
stakeholder actions and executive reporting, providing consistent visibility across distributed teams and
geographies.
• Improved Agile maturity and delivery governance by standardizing Definition of Ready/Done, Value Stream KPIs and
delivery metrics; strengthened PI Readiness, PI Planning, Value Stream/Solution Syncs, Executive Reviews and System
Demonstrations, improving Comparative Agility Score from 3.0 to 4.5 and reducing PI Planning preparation effort by
• Strengthened portfolio governance and executive visibility by establishing Power BI and Jira dashboards spanning
Portfolio Health, Program Status, PI Readiness, Team Performance, Delivery Health, OKRs and KPI tracking, while
partnering with Product Management to improve backlog quality, Epic definition, prioritization and roadmap
readiness.

• Designed and implemented six AI -powered Microsoft Copilot agents integrated with Jira to automate epic/user- story creation, dependency analysis, risk identification and executive reporting; reduced Program Risks by 30%,
Product Planning effort by 50% and Executive Reporting effort by 65%, while improving leadership confidence with
consistent, current delivery data.
• Protected an at -risk PI objective by identifying a shared Architecture dependency during PI Planning, quantifying
the effort, securing executive reprioritization, and resolving the dependency within the first two sprints; the
governance improvements subsequently contributed to a 50% reduction in dependency -resolution time.
• Directed planning, sync, execution and delivery across distributed Offshore -Onshore team structures, coordinating
cadence and handoffs between the Chennai -based delivery organization and onshore stakeholders in North
America, Europe and Canada.
• Owned JIRA hygiene and sprint planning oversight across teams: enforced backlog readiness, decomposition of
work into epics/stories with traceable acceptance criteria and  coordinated sprint commitments to improve
predictability and delivery cadence.
